prompts.label: 向右移动
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: GPT酱 formal iteration v2, ONE animation-state key pose for review.
Reference image is the user's APPROVED two-pose study. Its LEFT idle figure is the primary character identity reference; RIGHT waiting figure confirms the SAME face and costume. Make exactly ONE full-body drawing of that same girl, keeping her apparent age, graceful approximately 4.5-head stylized proportions, facial structure, alert lavender eyes, silver-white long wavy hair, two curved white horns, pointed ears, white dragon wings with lavender membranes, and long visibly scaled white/lavender tail with pointed tip.
Precisely retain the approved classic white/lavender fitted high-collar draped dress, open shoulders, detached hanging ruffled sleeves, asymmetrical slit and long train, cool silver chain/tassel details, clearly organized knot/rosette motifs on hair, waist and hem, and matching shoes. Keep consistent motif count and placement as far as visible from this pose. Keep crisp linework, restrained soft shading, cool palette and clear silhouette for later use in a 192x208 sprite. Full body from horn tips to shoes and entire tail must fit with generous margin. Same character and outfit, no redesign, no added props.
Personality: composed, self-possessed, capable, lightly playful; alert rather than sleepy, friendly without excessive blush or exaggerated reaction. No new outfit or alternate mode. No text, labels, captions, frame grid, floor, cast shadow, glow, fog, grey aura, gradient or scenery. True transparent background with fully opaque character interior and clean anti-aliased boundary. Single figure centered.
Specific pose: Facing SCREEN RIGHT in a three-quarter right-facing brisk walking stride. Her head follows the direction of movement, calm focused open eyes and closed relaxed mouth. One foot leads forward and the other pushes off, modest natural arm swing. Keep the dress train, sleeves and tail trailing behind to SCREEN LEFT, wings slightly drawn in to move comfortably, retain their structure and long flowing dress. Balanced readable silhouette, head size exactly consistent with the approved character. This is a directional movement state, not the working/thinking state.

prompts.label: 跳跃／完成庆祝
prompts.prompt:
undefined
Specific pose: Show the APEX OF A SMALL CONFIDENT CELEBRATION JUMP. Entire body visibly airborne, both feet raised with knees modestly bent, dress train and sleeves following upward momentum and curving below, coherent dress coverage. Eyes remain calmly attentive, eyebrows neutral and mouth just slightly open; NO broad grin, no blush, no excited squeezed-shut eyes. Preserve the earlier explicit request for a neutral slightly-open-mouth airborne expression. Wings slightly open for balance, tail forms a natural counterweight. Whole figure, horns, feet, wing tips and tail tip inside the canvas. No floor or shadow; the bent knees and lifted fabric should establish airborne action. This is one key pose, not a jump sequence.

prompts.label: 失败
prompts.prompt:
undefined
Specific pose: Facing viewer in a subtle three-quarter stance, a brief composed response to a failed attempt: shoulders lower just a little, wings gently draw inward, one hand settles near waist and the other lightly touches the forearm. Gaze looks slightly down and aside, brows lightly knit in thought, closed neutral mouth. Keep posture dignified and capable, head upright enough that eyes are visible. Tail rests in a low calm curve. Convey a small reflective pause before trying again, NO crying, tears, pleading, fear, sad puppy eyes, exaggerated slumping or self-blame.

prompts.label: 工作中
prompts.prompt:
undefined
Specific pose: WORKING / ACTIVELY PROCESSING, not walking. Stand firmly, slight purposeful forward inclination, focused alert gaze directed ahead and a little down, closed mouth and lightly concentrated brows. BOTH forearms held modestly forward near waist/chest level, hands making a small deliberate arranging/processing gesture, one hand a little higher than the other, natural five-finger anatomy. A confident measured sense of 'handling the task'. Wings moderately drawn back and tail in a gently poised curve. Clear silhouette distinct from the approved waiting open-palm greeting and from a hand-on-chin review pose. Keep elegant posture, NO keyboard, desk, hologram, book, magic orb or other invented props, no nervousness or tired eyes.

prompts.label: 检查中
prompts.prompt:
undefined
Specific pose: REVIEWING / CAREFULLY EVALUATING, not walking. Upright composed slightly three-quarter stance, one hand lightly supporting the chin (knuckles or index finger near chin, do not cover mouth or eyes), the other forearm held naturally across waist supporting the thinking pose. Small head tilt and focused, evaluating open eyes directed slightly down; one brow may lift subtly, mouth closed and thoughtful. Wings held calmly, tail in a quiet deliberate curve. Conveys checking work with independent judgment, distinct from both-hands-forward active working and from approved open-palm waiting. NO sleepy half-closed eyes, no anxiety, no book, glasses, magnifier or other invented props.
